raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the relevant “Anna of Hungary” by (incorrectly) using the Britannica entry for Anna of Hungary (1226–1270), daughter of Béla IV and Maria Laskarina, instead of the Byzantine empress Anna (c. 1260–1281), daughter of Stephen V and Elizabeth the Cuman, who married Andronikos II. This failure to disambiguate led to the wrong maternal grandmother (Maria Laskarina) rather than the correct one (Elizabeth the Cuman).
